kind: Retained normal-start native design failure, not publication proof
observed: All 354 exact-source model/save/contract checks passed before browser execution.
The normal-start journey reached the clinic at full health, earned the clinic battery, genuine version-4 shelter save and second crafted medkit, then climbed the real observation terrace.
The direct terrace-to-receiver crossing reached -8,-10 at 66 health and 0,-8 at 32 health, then died around x=1.53,z=-10.03 before the receiver or explicit medkit recovery could be reached.
No JavaScript or console error caused the failure.
design_interpretation: The direct street transfer treated technical connectivity as sufficient and ignored existing cover relationships. The shared design standard requires likely mistakes to have a viable next action and expects route knowledge to create agency.
correction: Do not add another hard wall. Make the slower intended approach reuse the existing market-low counter, fountain and east grass as a cover/concealment chain, while the direct crossing remains the faster exposed option.
Add only faded render-only freight floor marks to connect those existing features visually; collision, patrols and supplies remain unchanged.
Keep healing a discrete Classic D-pad-up player action at a reached recovery point. No movement helper may inject health or auto-heal.
runtime_preservation: Enemy health/damage/range, patrol points, existing market counter/fountain/grass, task reward, saves, objectives, Xbox mapping and XR modes are unchanged. The correction changes route intention/readability, not threat statistics.
evidence_boundary: This is one automated virtual-controller route. Passing the revised route can prove exercised recovery software paths, not human comprehension, balance preference or physical-device approval.
